name: Shield, Greater
body:
School abjuration [force]; Level alchemist 4, bloodrager 4, magus 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner/unchained summoner 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)s

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell the material component breaks apart into a dozen pieces which float around you and protect you from harm. You gain all the benefits of shield except as follows. The bonus to AC increases to +6 and it can absorb up to 12 levels worth of ray spells directed at you.

When you are targeted by a ray you make a caster level check against it with a DC of 11 + the caster level of the ray. If you succeed the ray is deflected harmlessly to a side. You may instead choose to expend twice as many levels as needed to deflect the ray to redirect it back onto its original caster. You use the ray’s original attack roll to determine if the ray strikes its new target.
